proposed_rules.trigger: A full-width [bg:gradient] or [bg:image] zone with zero captured child text, positioned as the last content zone immediately above the footer.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag for Phase 2 targeted extraction as a likely CTA banner (heading+button) rather than silently applying decorative-graphics-are-noise.
proposed_rules.rationale: Recurs identically across the page-10/page-11 templates in the same position with a reserved height, suggesting real CTA copy that failed to render at capture width, not intentional decoration. Rejected alternative: treating it as pure decoration and dropping it.

provenance.evidence: C108 rc1c2c2 [bg:gradient] 1280x507 with no child text, directly before footer rc2

proposed_rules.trigger: A [NxM] grid of category link labels rendered at a y-position overlapping the nav bar/hero rather than in normal document flow, indicating a hover/click-triggered dropdown promoted by the capture tool's overlay detection.
proposed_rules.decision: Fold into the nav section as a flyout/mega-menu note; exclude from the page's content block inventory.
proposed_rules.rationale: The node's absolute position (y=419, overlapping the hero at y=423) plus its category-label content matches a nav mega-menu, not page content. Rejected alternative: modeling it as a standalone 'mega-menu' block in the main content area.

provenance.evidence: C108 rc1c2c3 [4x2] @150,419 1000x112 overlapping hero at y=423
